facts.business: Samor Reality Limited is engaged in the real estate sector, developing residential projects and recognizing revenue upon transfer of control of assets to customers.

auditor.name: S S Lunkad & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to effects of matters described in the 'Basis for Opinion' section; Key audit matters include revenue recognition for real estate projects under Ind AS 115 and assessing carrying value of inventory (Rs. 10,015.68 lacs as at March 31, 2026).

key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant judgement in identifying performance obligations and determining transfer of control under Ind AS 115
Inventory valuation depends on estimates of net realizable value based on market conditions, project timelines, and future selling prices
facts.related_party_note: No related party transactions during the year (Form AOC-2 shows NIL for both non-arm's length and arm's length transactions).
